content: This approach is designed to secure long-term partnerships with enterprise clients, ensuring a steady and predictable stream of revenue while managing large numbers of vehicles simultaneously. In contrast, retail-focused providers rely heavily on individual transactions and walk-ins. Their operational framework is designed to handle a high frequency of distinct, independent service requests, requiring flexible scheduling and dynamic inventory management to accommodate unpredictable daily demand. The fleet management sector globally grew to exceed USD 27 billion in 2025, with projections indicating a 16.9 percent compound annual growth rate from 2026 to 2035 [11] . This rapid expansion in the fleet sector is largely underpinned by data-driven decision-making and the integration of advanced tools such as telematics, artificial intelligence, and interconnected devices [11] . Because commercial fleets and industrial vehicles represent revenue-generating assets for their operators, any period of inactivity translates directly to financial loss. Consequently, service providers in this space must prioritize proactive interventions that keep air-conditioning and climate control systems functioning optimally before catastrophic failures occur. Modern fleet operational models have moved beyond merely scaling vehicle numbers, with success increasingly defined by complex metrics such as driver engagement, route optimization, and overarching data visibility [12] . One notable feature of these modern models is the emphasis on analytics, utilizing telematic data to plan maintenance schedules and reduce downtimes effectively. Furthermore, fostering driver welfare and retention has emerged as a critical focus within fleet management, requiring robust strategies around driver support, which includes maintaining optimal in-cabin climate control for driver comfort and safety [15] . Conversely, retail-focused providers prioritize the immediate customer experience and rapid, reactive repair. When individual vehicle owners experience air-conditioning failures, their primary concern is restoring personal comfort as quickly as possible. Therefore, retail competitors must excel in customer service, transparent communication, and efficient, on-the-spot diagnostics and repairs to build brand loyalty and secure positive consumer reviews. The divergence in operational models and service priorities is intrinsically linked to the respective customer bases of each segment.
